01 About

From code
to clarity

I'm a software engineer with 4+ years building products that span the full stack — React and TypeScript on the front end, Java and Python underneath, and Kafka-driven microservices on AWS holding it all together. Currently at JPMorgan Chase, previously at Accenture.

Lately that's meant going deeper into AI systems — LangChain, MCP, RAG pipelines, and the harder problem of evaluating whether an LLM's output is actually good. I like the seam between clean infrastructure and the layer people actually touch.

03 My Process

How I ship

01

Understand

Read the system before touching it. Trace the data path, find where it actually breaks, not where it looks broken.

02

Design

Sketch the architecture before the code. Fewer moving parts, clear ownership, failure modes named up front.

03

Build

Ship in small, reviewable increments. Tests around the seams that matter, not everywhere equally.

04

Verify

Instrument it, watch it under real load, and only then call it done.
